paper_metadata.title: Enhancing Quantum Machine Learning Algorithms for Optimized Financial Portfolio Management

summary: The paper proposes a QSVM-based approach for financial portfolio management using a Kaggle stock dataset and reports portfolio performance of 89.65%, compared with QPCA (78.34%), QBM (64.67%), and QKC (71.89%). The method also reports a 25% risk–return tradeoff and 32.12% efficiency frontier metric, but provides no quantum circuit details, qubit counts, hardware execution, or classical baselines.

experiments.description: Proposed QSVM-based financial portfolio management experiment using Python with classical-quantum hybrid preprocessing, quantum circuit optimization, and noise mitigation; compared against QPCA, QBM, and QKC baselines.
